NONE: › a serious disease caused by bacteria entering the human body through small cuts, causing the muscles, especially around the mouth, to become tight and stop working
› easily made angry, unhappy, or upset
易怒的，暴躁的；情緒易波動的

example: Be careful what you say to Anna - she's been a little tetchy lately.
你跟安娜說話時得小心點——她近來情緒很不好。

NONE: › an informal private conversation between two people, especially friends
兩人密談；（尤指朋友間的）促膝談心
› in private with only two people together

example: We must have a tête-à-tête sometime.
我們哪天得坐下來好好聊聊。
我們兩人單獨一起用餐。

NONE: › a rope or chain used to tie, especially an animal, to a post or other fixed place, usually so that it can move freely within a small area
› a group of four cells produced during cell division
› a solid shape whose four surfaces are triangles
四面體（一種立體圖形，有四個三角形平面）
› a heart disease present at birth where the heart has four faults at the same time
法洛四聯症，法洛氏四重症

example: Most cases of tetralogy of Fallot can be corrected by surgery.
大部分法洛四聯症可以通過手術矯正。
